Chhattisgarh to review Maoist cases, potentially clearing accused

The Chhattisgarh government has decided to review cases against individuals accused of Maoist activities. This review aims to withdraw cases that do not involve fatal charges, potentially leading to the release of those accused. The move comes as part of a broader effort to address legal proceedings related to Maoist insurgency in the state.
